Low Water Level - Arctic - Chesterfield Narrows
Low water levels reported at 63 59.491N 094 18.157W.
Observed water levels at tide station 05160 Chesterfield Narrows are up to 0.5 m lower than predicted and may fall below chart datum by up to 0.1 m at low tide. Mariners should use the observed water levels and exercise caution when navigating through this area.
